# The Interaction List

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

Each System Pack's section of the World's Interaction List, `configure/<pack id>.yaml`: what its rules, parameters and consequences may name (`docs/MODULE_SPEC.md` §4.2 states the list's rules).

## The shape every section shares

Every key is optional.

| Key | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `consequences` | What this pack's facts mean for who perceives them and for history. |
| `default` | What an action no rule matches gets: permit (when unsaid) or forbid. |
| `extends` | A reference list of this pack to start from; the section's entries are added after it. Chains of at most four lists, with no cycle. |
| `parameters` | This pack's numbers, for everyone or for the classes the entry names. |
| `regions` | Places whose own entries override the world's there, by place key. |
| `rules` | Who may do what to whom: rules about this pack's actions. |

Each entry of a list:

| Entry | Its keys |
| --- | --- |
| `rules` | A rule: an action, a selector per role it names, and permit or forbid. The most specific matching rule wins; between equals, forbid. |
| `parameters` | A parameter entry: a selector per role it names, and the parameters it sets. With no role named it is the section's base. |
| `consequences` | A consequence entry: for one fact and a selector per role it names, its audience, whether it is biographical, and the pack's knobs. |

A role key (`actor`, `target`, `object`, `place`) holds a selector: * for anyone, or an entity class: one defined in configure/classes.yaml, or an implicit class (person, place, item, organization).

Each pack's entry below lists the actions, roles, facts, parameters and knobs its section may name; a value or key it does not list is refused. Its JSON Schema, under `schema/`, states the whole shape.

## `configure/conversation.yaml`

Read when `world.yaml` lists `conversation` under `configure:`.
Read by the `conversation` system (package `mineworld-conversation`), which a world enables in `systems:`.

configure/conversation.yaml: this pack's section of the World's Interaction List. Every key is optional; an empty file keeps the pack's own defaults.

Any other key is refused with `is not a key of a section`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
parameters:
  - forget_after_days: 0
rules:
  - action: talk
    effect: permit
```

### Actions of `configure/conversation.yaml`

| Action | Roles a rule may name | A region may scope it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `talk` | `actor`, `target`, `place` | yes |

### Facts of `configure/conversation.yaml`

| Fact | Roles an entry may name | Audience | Narrowest audience | Biography configurable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spoke` | `actor`, `target`, `place` | `place` | `participants` | yes |
| `conversation-started` | `actor`, `target`, `place` | `participants` | `participants` | yes |

### Parameters of `configure/conversation.yaml`

A parameter entry may name `actor`, `target`, `place`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forget_after_days` | whole number | no | `0` | 0 to 3650 | Days a listener keeps a line; 0 keeps it until `remembered` pushes it out (`ARC-86`). |
| `gap` | whole number | no | `300` | 1 to 86400 | Seconds of silence after which the next exchange starts a new conversation. |
| `range` | whole number | no | `3000` | 1 to 100000 | Millimetres a voice reaches: how close a listener must be. |
| `remembered` | whole number | no | `32` | 1 to 64 | How many exchanges a listener's history keeps. |

### Knobs of `configure/conversation.yaml`

A consequence entry may set these.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remember` | true or false | no | `true` | — | Whether the listener remembers the line, among the exchanges their history keeps. |

**Reference lists** a section may `extends`: `default`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |

### Types used above

<a id="configure-relationships-block-curvename"></a>

#### `CurveName`

The name of a curve, such as none, linear, half-life or power: 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -.

**Type:** text. **Bounds:** matches `^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$`.
